mapper.sql: select field_id, material_id, field_key, field_value, field_type, confidence, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from assess_material_field
mapper.select: where material_id = #{materialId} and del_flag = '0' order by field_id
mapper.update: update assess_material_field set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where material_id = #{materialId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into assess_material_field (material_id, field_key, field_value, field_type, confidence, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values
(#{field.materialId}, #{field.fieldKey}, #{field.fieldValue}, #{field.fieldType}, #{field.confidence}, #{field.createBy}, sysdate(), '0')
